card.name: Words before sharps container or size comparison
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, as, of, in, nearest) right before a container or object noun, mainly in needle and syringe disposal text. Also the digit 1 at the start of gauge or French sizes such as 18-gauge or 12 French.
